note: The other half of the Fixnum-boundary family: a positive Bignum, a Fixnum that is an exact multiple, and a negative Bignum whose remainder is 1, f/2 or f-1 all take a CRuby path that lands on the multiple truncation wants, so they keep answering. They also keep the gate in `integer-truncate-bignum-exact-multiple` exact — it may only fire on a negative Bignum that the granularity divides.
